The '''2018–19 [[Cypriot First Division]]''' was the 80th season of the Cypriot top-level [[Association football|football]] league.

==Teams==

===Promotion and relegation (pre-season)===
[[Aris Limassol FC|Aris Limassol]] and [[Ethnikos Achna FC|Ethnikos Achna]] were relegated at the end of the first phase of the [[2017–18 Cypriot First Division|2017–18 season]] after finishing in the bottom two places of the table. They were joined by [[Olympiakos Nicosia]], who finished at the bottom of the second-phase relegation group.

The relegated teams were replaced by [[2017–18 Cypriot Second Division|2017–18 Second Division]] champions [[Enosis Neon Paralimni FC|Enosis Neon Paralimni]].
